compiled_state.title: GREEN: implement plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh to pass all tests from Task 1 (c607-c3d1-783f-4679).

Script responsibilities:
1. Enumerate commits in the session PR range (main..session-HEAD) via git log
2. For each commit, apply 3-signal cross-check in order:
   a. DSO-Story-Merge trailer in commit message → treat as provenanced via squash-merge resolution
   b. gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pulls → find associated PR
   c. gh api check-runs on that PR's head SHA → find per-branch-review check with conclusion=success
3. Exponential backoff on 403/429: initial sleep 2s, double per retry, cap at 60s
4. 200-call API budget ceiling (override via DSO_API_BUDGET env var for tests); exit non-zero with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED on exhaustion
5. SHA→PR cache: write resolved SHA→PR mappings to ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/provenance-cache.json (or env-overridable path); on rerun, load cache and skip already-resolved SHAs
6. On un-provenanced SHAs: report each SHA on stderr, write list to integration review scope input file (${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/integration-review-scope.txt or env-overridable path); exit non-zero

Environment overrides for test isolation (follow resolve-session-branch.sh pattern):
- DSO_SESSION_RANGE: override 'main..HEAD' git log range
- DSO_GH_API_OVERRIDE: directory of per-call mock response files
- DSO_API_BUDGET: integer budget ceiling override
- DSO_CACHE_PATH: override cache file path
- DSO_SCOPE_FILE: override scope output file path

Must pass all 8 tests in test-verify-session-provenance.sh.
chmod +x must be set on the script.

Testing mode: GREEN
